summary: Map property deal workflows, controls and settlement records with blockchain. Explore practical transaction design and enrol in the five-day course.
lede: Blockchain in real estate transactions helps teams map sale and transfer events while aligning ledger records with off-chain documents. For property transaction analysts, conveyancing operations leads and digital transformation specialists, the course covers assessing data readiness, defining participant permissions and reconciling settlement messages. Practical exercises develop workflow maps, exception controls and a draft implementation roadmap.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who coordinate property deal records, approvals, identity evidence or settlement processes and need to assess where distributed ledgers may fit into those workflows.
modules: Ethereum Deal Event and State Models
W3C Verifiable Credentials for Property Evidence
prerequisites: Working familiarity with real estate transaction stages, such as acquisition, sale or transfer, is expected. Basic blockchain concepts are useful; no coding or programming is required.
